title: Decide branching + versioning scheme for Runtime LTS (branch name, tags, pinning semantics)
creator: Connor O'Brien
description:
We need a final decision for (1) the long-lived LTS branch naming, (2) git tag naming for LTS patches, and (3) how this maps cleanly to version pinning semantics in Redwood Private installer + Helm charts.

This ticket exists because we had competing proposals:
- Use release/* branches (e.g., release/1.18-lts)
- Use runtime-*-lts branches (e.g., runtime-1.18-lts)
- Use tags only (no long-lived branch) and cherry-pick to a moving tag

Constraints:
- LTS needs to be auditable/reproducible: artifacts traceable to commits; release notes and SBOM/provenance should map back to a stable branch and tag.
- Private/Helm need deterministic pinning without “accidentally” drifting to mainline 1.18.x.
- Tooling should be obvious to engineers doing backports (and not collide with existing short-lived RC/release branches).

Stakeholders consulted: Sahana Iyer (CI/build), Bruno Silva + Vivek Kulkarni (Private/Helm), Marissa Cole (product visibility), Sean Gallagher (SRE/on-call).

Decision outcome is captured below and in ADR-027; this Linear ticket is the canonical implementation checklist + comms trail.
decision_summary:
Final decision (approved 2025-02-03):

1) Branching model
- Create one long-lived LTS branch per supported minor: runtime-<minor>-lts
  - Example: runtime-1.18-lts
- Branch cut point: from the mainline runtime tag for the minor’s baseline (e.g., v1.18.0), immediately after the baseline has cleared perf + correctness gates.
- Keep existing release/* branches reserved for short-lived RC coordination (weeks), not 6–12+ month support.

2) Git tags
- Use semver with an explicit -lts suffix:
  - v1.18.0-lts (baseline tag on the LTS branch)
  - v1.18.1-lts, v1.18.2-lts, ... (patch tags on the LTS branch)
- Non-LTS mainline remains standard semver (v1.18.1, v1.18.2, ...) and MUST NOT be reused for LTS artifacts.

3) Container image tags (Hosted/Dedicated/Private)
- Runtime image tags MUST match the LTS git tag without the leading 'v':
  - 1.18.1-lts
- Each published LTS image must also publish the immutable digest in release notes (customer pinning best practice).
- Do not publish a moving 'lts' or '1.18-lts-latest' tag for now (avoids accidental drift; can revisit when Console pinning UX is GA).

4) Private installer pinning semantics
- Private installer will accept a fully-qualified runtime image tag like 1.18.1-lts, and optionally a digest pin.
- Installer will display and record:
  - runtime_version: 1.18.1-lts
  - runtime_image_digest: sha256:...
  - runtime_git_tag: v1.18.1-lts
- Checksums/provenance verification ties back to the git tag (release manager publishes both tag + artifact manifest).

5) Helm chart pinning semantics
- Helm values will support:
  - runtime.image.tag: "1.18.1-lts"
  - runtime.image.digest: "sha256:..." (optional, recommended)
- Chart annotations should include the release notes URL for that exact patch.

6) Version comparison / semver caveat
- Acknowledge that '-lts' is a semver pre-release marker and may sort lower than the base version in strict semver comparators.
- Mitigation:
  - Do not rely on semver ordering for LTS selection.
  - Selection is explicit by tag/digest (Console + installer + Helm).
  - Internally, tooling may parse base semver by stripping '-lts' only for reporting/dashboards (not for resolving “latest”).
acceptance_criteria:
- ADR-027 is updated/approved with the above scheme and linked from this ticket.
- runtime-1.18-lts branch name finalized and used consistently across PRs, CI, and docs.
- Tag format (vX.Y.Z-lts) implemented and validated with release tooling.
- Private installer can pin by LTS patch tag (and digest) without treating it as a non-semver error.
- Helm chart supports runtime.image.tag set to X.Y.Z-lts, plus optional digest pin.
- Comms note posted in #eng-releases and shared with Support/CS so they can guide customers on pinning best practices.
implementation_notes:
Implementation checklist (owned by Release Eng, with Private/Helm collaboration):
- [x] Repo conventions: confirm branch naming 'runtime-<minor>-lts' (no 'release/' prefix).
- [x] Update CI branch filters to include runtime-*-lts (Sahana).
- [x] Update release automation to generate tags vX.Y.Z-lts on LTS branch.
- [x] Confirm container publish job generates image tag 'X.Y.Z-lts' and records digest for notes.
- [x] Private installer: allow '-lts' suffix in version pin fields; support checksum/digest verification (Bruno/Vivek).
- [x] Helm: add values + docs; surface release notes URL annotation (Bruno).
- [x] Docs: customer-facing pinning guidance emphasizes digest pin for regulated deployments.

Open follow-ups (non-blocking):
- Consider introducing 'runtime-1.18-lts-latest' *only* after Console pinning UI includes guardrails/warnings.
- Decide if we need an internal 'lts-base-version' field in artifact metadata for analytics/rollups (would live in provenance json).
activity: 2025-01-29 — Connor O'Brien: Created ticket after #eng-releases thread showed confusion between release/* and runtime-*-lts. Need to unblock PR-23184 branch cut and downstream pinning work.

2025-01-30 — Bruno Silva: Helm chart currently assumes semver-ish tags (1.18.1). If we go with 1.18.1-lts, we should avoid any code that tries to semver-compare and auto-select latest. Explicit pin is fine; we can also support digest.

2025-01-30 — Vivek Kulkarni: Private installer parses versions in a couple places for display/validation. We can treat it as a string + verify via digest/checksum. We should not “upgrade to latest” automatically for Private anyway (change control).

2025-01-31 — Sahana Iyer: CI branch filter change is straightforward. Strong preference to keep release/* branches short-lived; long-lived release/* complicates secrets + retention policies we already have for RC workflows.

2025-02-01 — Marissa Cole: From a customer UX standpoint, the channel name should be obvious. '-lts' in the version string is fine as long as release notes clearly say 'LTS patch'. Console can present 'Channel: LTS' and 'Version: 1.18.1-lts'.
2025-02-02 — Sean Gallagher: SRE preference: stable branch name for dashboards/alerts and rollouts. runtime-1.18-lts is easy to target for release monitoring and incident retro mapping.

2025-02-03 — Connor O'Brien: Decision recorded in ADR-027; aligned with Runtime leads. Proceeding with runtime-1.18-lts branch + vX.Y.Z-lts tags. Marking ticket Done; downstream work tracked in ENG-4827/4828/4824.
